/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from pathlib import Path
import os, re
base=Path(os.environ['TMPDIR'])/'itm-university-verify'
urls=(base/'course_urls.txt').read_text().splitlines()
files=sorted(base.glob('*_detail_*.html'))
for url,f in zip(urls,files):
    txt=f.read_text(errors='ignore')
    soup=BeautifulSoup(txt,'html.parser')
    title=' '.join(soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True).split()) if soup.title else ''
    hs=[]
    for tag in soup.find_all(['h1','h2','h3','h4','h5','h6']):
        t=' '.join(tag.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
        if t and t not in hs and len(t)<180:
            hs.append(t)
    # keep headings containing program/course/degree/name or first few meaningful content headings
    selected=[x for x in hs if re.search(r'B\\.Tech|BCA|BBA|B\\.Com|MBA|MCA|M\\.Tech|M\\.Pharm|M\\.Sc|Nursing|Ph\\.D|B\\.Pharm|Diploma|Programme|Program|Course|ACCA|P\\.B|PBB|Agriculture|Science|Sports|Yoga',x,re.I)]
    desc=' '.join(soup.find('meta',attrs={'name':'description'}).get('content','').split()) if soup.find('meta',attrs={'name':'description'}) else ''
    print(f'{url}\\n  TITLE: {title}\\n  DESC: {desc}\\n  HEAD: ' + ' | '.join(selected[:16]))
PY"
